grammar_focus: KS31 would / used to 表过去习惯性动作(would 过去反复动作、used to 过去习惯/状态、状态只能 used to)主考;SD used to do / be used to doing / be used to do 三结构辨析 + gold vs golden + 课文 dig/bury 过去式、give up、All that glitters is not gold(辅考)。素材=Aaron 净化生产包(2026-07-05,原课文内容过滤误判已核无害)
scene: 我小时候,我朋友 Danny 的爸爸坚信他家后院埋着黄金。他过去常跟我们说,很久以前海盗把宝藏藏在了那儿。有一天他买了台叫“探宝者”的金属探测器,它是用来探测黄金和其他金属的。每个周末他都会拿着它在院子里走来走去,听有没有“嘀”声。每次它一响,他就会抓起铲子开始挖。他挖了那么多洞,后院看起来像月球表面。可他找到的全是些旧钉子、瓶盖,还有一把生锈的勺子。“闪光的未必是金子,”我爸爸总会笑着说。Danny 的爸爸从没找到宝藏,但他也从没放弃。现在回想,那个后院从来就不是金矿——但那些周末是金子般的回忆。

grammar_card.title: would / used to 表过去习惯
grammar_card.intro: KS31:would + 动词原形表示'过去常常(反复)做某动作';used to + 动词原形表示'过去的习惯或状态(现在不再)'。要点:表示过去的'状态'(如 live、be、have)只能用 used to,不能用 would。另注意 used 三结构:used to do(过去常做)/ be used to doing(习惯于做)/ be used to do(被用来做)。

rows: He used to tell us stories.
There used to be a tree here.
be used to doing 习惯于
I'm used to getting up early.
be used to do 被用来做
It is used to detect gold.

specialRules.rule: 过去的'状态'(live/be/have 等)只能用 used to,不能用 would;would 只表反复的'动作'。
gold(名词/材质:a gold watch)≠ golden(形容词/比喻:a golden opportunity、a golden memory);谚语 All that glitters is not gold。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What did the team (Danny's dad) find?
options: Only old nails, bottle caps, and a rusty spoon — no gold

passage: When I was a kid, my friend Danny's dad was sure there was gold buried in their backyard. He used to tell us that pirates had hidden their treasure there long ago. One day he bought a metal detector called 'The Revealer.' It has been used to detect gold and other metals. Every weekend he would walk around the yard with it, listening for a beep. Whenever it beeped, he would grab a shovel and start digging. He dug so many holes that the backyard looked like the surface of the moon. But all he ever found were old nails, bottle caps, and a rusty spoon. 'All that glitters is not gold,' my dad would say with a grin. Danny's dad never found any treasure, but he never gave up either. Looking back, I think the backyard was never a gold mine — but those weekends were a golden memory.
